name: Notifico Self-Hosted Notification Server
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted notification server with pipelines, templates, and API delivery through SMTP email, SMS and messaging transport integrations; no software subscription or vendor-enforced message quota.
watch_out: Bring your own server, database and transport credentials; SMTP/SMS/messaging providers may charge separately or impose quotas. No free hosted sending allowance is included. Review deployment security and maintenance before production.
